title: Audit transfer provenance and boundaries
commitMessage: docs: audit transfer provenance and boundaries

contribution.summary: Audit the pinned source corpus and transfer exclusions, complete every locally decidable M0-W02-C01 boundary, and leave the redistribution decision explicitly blocked until written owner/AURA evidence exists.
contribution.value: Creates a durable provenance and transfer-boundary record without copying source or inventing license rights, while keeping product backlog and native DWF progress synchronized in the same payload.
debtChanges: EXT-SOURCE-RIGHTS remains blocked because the Math repository contains no written origin/redistribution decision for inherited AURA source.
No distributable AURA source is copied, no external repository is mutated, and no publication or package-identity decision is authorized.
contribution.nextAction: Obtain written origin and redistribution evidence from the human owner or AURA maintainer; then resume M0-W02-C01-T1-C and complete the phase only if the pinned corpus still reconciles.

achievements.achievement: The provenance question and decision criterion are bounded to the pinned source manifest, exact file identity, and written redistribution authority.
A bounded observation records 54 selected files, repository heads, SHA-256 provenance scope, and the absence of written redistribution authority in Math.
The transfer-boundary question is fixed around mathematical source/tests only, with secrets, private data, binaries, host policies, and unrelated domains excluded.
Existing inventory, constitution, baseline, and coordination contracts provide bounded evidence for the allowed and excluded transfer classes.
The transfer-boundary decision is recorded: no source copy without rights evidence, no cross-repository mutation, and explicit reconciliation on source drift.
M0-W02-C01 transfer limits and integration boundaries are qualified while the separate redistribution-rights task remains honestly blocked.
